name: 33184 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33184 (Miami) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33184 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33184 (Miami) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 71% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
